sentences.en: It was all the more depressing because it was raining.
sentences.zh: 因为当时正在下雨，所以这更让人感到沮丧。

sentences.en: You seem to be depressed this morning. What's the matter?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上看起来有点不开心。怎么了？

sentences.en: I cannot look back on my adolescence without feeling depressed.
sentences.zh: 每次回想起我的青少年时期都会感到很沮丧。

senses.zh: 使抑郁，使沮丧；降低，抑制；使萧条，使不景气；按下，压下
